links.outcome: Correctness, completeness, clarity of AI vs trainee PET/CT impressions rated blindly by physicians
links.effect: Correct 92% AI vs 91% trainee (P=.80); completeness higher for AI (mean 4.52 vs 4.09, P<.001); clarity, organization, satisfaction similar; AI more often criticized for excess length (33% vs 0%).
links.quote: AI-generated impressions were rated as correct in 92% of reports (mean 0.92, SD 0.27) and trainee-generated impressions rated as correct in 91% of reports (mean 0.91, SD 0.29; P=.80, negligible effect size).

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM to draft radiology/nuclear medicine report impressions from findings, with attention to diagnostic certainty terminology

screen.reason: The study empirically compares impressions of nuclear medicine PET/CT reports generated by ChatGPT-4o versus those generated by radiology trainees, evaluated offline by expert physicians, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
